product_one_liner.value: SpotDraft is an AI-native contract lifecycle management platform that helps legal teams create, review, negotiate, approve, sign, and manage contracts.
product_one_liner.notes: SpotDraft describes an AI-native CLM platform for legal teams covering creation, review, negotiation, approvals, e-signatures and post-signature management: https://www.spotdraft.com/llm-info

pricing_page.notes: SpotDraft has a public pricing-and-plans page describing flexible pricing based on users or contract volume: https://www.spotdraft.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The customer-logo area labels both Oyster and Quizlet as clients under 'Trusted by fast moving teams': https://www.spotdraft.com/teams/hr | named_customers.0: Oyster appears as a client logo in the customer section: https://www.spotdraft.com/teams/hr | named_customers.1: Quizlet appears as a client logo in the customer section: https://www.spotdraft.com/teams/hr

employee_band.notes: The company profile lists 201–500 employees, and the funding database profile reports 234 employees, which falls in the same requested band. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/spotdraft and https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/582c1ccce4b0b8897fdab9a7/spotdraft#a:about

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company's funding announcement explicitly says it is headquartered in Bengaluru, with an office in New York: https://www.spotdraft.com/blog/spotdraft-secures-54-million-to-lead-ai-contract-lifecycle-management . Conflicting directory listings reduce confidence. | hq_country: SpotDraft explicitly identifies Bengaluru, India as its headquarters and New York as an office: https://www.spotdraft.com/blog/spotdraft-secures-54-million-to-lead-ai-contract-lifecycle-management . This explicit company statement is preferred over conflicting directory listings identifying New York.

founded_year.notes: The company-issued announcement explicitly states that SpotDraft was founded in 2017: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251203715744/en/SpotDraft-Bolsters-Leadership-Team-to-Scale-AI-Powered-CLM-Platform-Globally

eng_blog.notes: Two authored engineering posts describe actual implementation work: Anirudh Varma explains the front-end team's Angular-to-Nx monorepo migration, and Dhanshree Arora describes deploying predictive models and using Bazel for ML development. Their engineering involvement is supported by first-person implementation accounts, although formal job titles are not supplied. Sources: https://www.spotdraft.com/engineering-blog/frontend-migration-to-monorepo and https://www.spotdraft.com/engineering-blog/how-we-used-bazel-to-streamline-our-ai-development

public_docs.notes: The public developer FAQ links separate Platform 101 and Data Model guides, while the knowledge base also contains VerifAI and HubSpot integration articles. This is a multi-article documentation offering, not a lone FAQ. Sources: https://developer.spotdraft.com/docs/developer-faq, https://help.spotdraft.com/articles/5196339534-verifai-faqs and https://help.spotdraft.com/articles/6377755758-key-features-of-spotdraft-s-hubspot-integration

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Product Manager - AI posting has an application link and contains AI in its title, meeting the stated title-based rule: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/spotdraft/88fc1f00-e546-463a-8ba0-78bc89a95cc6

model_provider.value: GPT-4, hosted on Microsoft Azure Enterprise
model_provider.notes: The VerifAI FAQ explicitly identifies GPT-4 as its primary model and says it is hosted on Microsoft Azure Enterprise: https://help.spotdraft.com/articles/5196339534-verifai-faqs

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: SpotDraft's compliance page lists these four frameworks as compliant, rather than in progress. hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Account Executive - US posting explicitly says SpotDraft is hiring Account Executives and provides an application link: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/spotdraft/fcf8da74-e8f4-439c-808e-7b42e59550e1

launched_6mo.notes: On October 29, 2026, SpotDraft announced its Claude connector, allowing customers to connect contracts and query them in plain English. This new integration falls within the six-month window: https://www.spotdraft.com/blog/spotdraft-claude-connector

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The December 3, 2025 announcement names Alon Waks as Chief Marketing Officer and Amit Sharma as Chief Financial Officer, within the requested twelve-month window: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251203715744/en/SpotDraft-Bolsters-Leadership-Team-to-Scale-AI-Powered-CLM-Platform-Globally
